Too expensive, not that good!
Feb 2024 • Couples
Not the best experience unfortunately! It looks nice, you could call it pretentious. No reception when you enter, you walk around this large room, luckily there was a nice table ready. We ordered the most expensive dish on the menu, a lobster and seafood dish with a bottle of white wine. The wine was fine, you can't expect more in the Far East. Unfortunately it took way too long, staff running around rushing past your table, there is no structure in this restaurant. In the end it took over an hour after asking several times and several tables that received food earlier. My partner asked several times what was going on, but there was little response from the wait staff. Then you get the bill and the 15% holiday/service on the bill is not good.

Then the toilet, which was so dirty, hot and through a broken staircase is really not suitable for his restaurant. I wouldn't recommend it on the street, you can eat for a quarter much better.

Feb 2021 • Couples
My wife and I went to Bon Nua Park restaurant for an early evening dinner at 2:15pm on Friday, February 12 to celebrate the Lunar New; and the waitstaff was horrible and the food just as unpleasant. From the moment we sat down the lady setting the table leaned over me in an invasive manner to set the table up. Then I ordered a chocolate banana Oreo drink and I specifically asked for the drink to precede my food order. The waitstaff acknowledged my request but ignored my wishes and after a 30 minute wait they did just the opposite. During the 30 minute wait I repeatedly reminded the waitstaff about the delay in bringing my drink, to no avail. The Ca Bop (fish dish) that I had too fishy a taste and was overcooked along with all the other dishes that were also overcooked but with a bland taste. My milk shake drink that was more than 30 minutes late in coming was warm and fully melted upon its delivery. And if the food and soggy warm drink was not bad enough, the waitstaff kept sweeping the floor dust onto my food during the entire meal. 

Getting the waitstaff’s attention was worse than to trying to get the attention of a deaf and blind person. In fact I know physically challenged people who are far more attentive. When I finally got the waitstaff’s attention and complained their apology was so disingenuous that it prompted me with enough frustration to take my time to write this negative review. Normally I do not take any pleasure in complaining but writing this review is the most pleasant part of my dinner experience at Bon Nua Park restaurant.
